es.headline: Caribe y Sierra Nevada
es.intro: Descubre la bahía histórica, las playas y las montañas de Santa Marta.
es.history: Santa Marta, fundada en 1525, conserva en su centro la huella del puerto colonial. La Catedral y la Casa de la Aduana dialogan con el patrimonio indígena de la Sierra Nevada. En la Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino murió Simón Bolívar en 1830.

en.headline: The Caribbean and the Sierra Nevada
en.intro: Discover Santa Marta’s historic bay, beaches and mountains.
en.history: Founded in 1525, Santa Marta retains traces of its colonial port in the historic centre. The Cathedral and Customs House sit alongside the Indigenous heritage of the Sierra Nevada. Simón Bolívar died at the Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino in 1830.
en.business_title: Have a business in Santa Marta?
en.practical: Check access, transport and conditions with each venue or operator.

pt-BR.headline: Caribe e Sierra Nevada
pt-BR.intro: Descubra a baía histórica, as praias e as montanhas de Santa Marta.
pt-BR.history: Fundada em 1525, Santa Marta conserva no centro as marcas do porto colonial. A Catedral e a Casa da Aduana convivem com o patrimônio indígena da Sierra Nevada. Simón Bolívar morreu na Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino em 1830.
